costBasis: Per-instance cost averaged within each scenario, then across the four scenarios; not actual billing. Subscription-plan runs (Claude, GPT, Gemini, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and GLM 5.3 through OpenCode Go) are priced as the run's API-equivalent USD divided by that plan's weekly quota (in API-equivalent USD), times the plan's weekly price (planCost); Strata is at its local running cost

instanceCost.anthropic: Per-request tokens from the saved session (agent.json measurementFacts) at the anthropic rates below (cache writes at the 1-hour rate; Haiku by prompt length), API-equivalent USD; then the plan-fee conversion (planCost)
instanceCost.openai: Token counts at the openai rates below (API-equivalent USD); then the plan-fee conversion (planCost)
instanceCost.google: Token counts at the google rates below (output includes thinking), API-equivalent USD; then the plan-fee conversion (planCost)
instanceCost.opencode: Per-request list-price USD from the supplement (DeepSeek peak and off-peak, GLM; the list prices below), API-equivalent USD; then the plan-fee conversion (planCost)
instanceCost.strata: Local running cost from the instance work seconds and the localRunningCost settings below

gpt-6.2-sol.longContext: input above 272K: input and cache x2, output x1.5 (not applied: records hold totals only)

strata-iq3_xxs.notes: Home PC with an RTX 3080 Ti 12 GB, i9-13900 and 64 GB RAM. 400 W is a rough whole-system load estimate (350 W GPU board limit; memory-bound decoding usually draws less). Electricity is the Q1 2026 world household average (country-weighted). Maintenance covers wear parts at about USD 50 a year over about 2,500 loaded hours.

planCost.formula: cost USD = API-equivalent USD of the run / weeklyApiUsd of the plan x weekly price of the plan, where weekly price = monthlyUsd / daysPerMonth x 7

anthropic.name: Claude Max 20x
anthropic.weeklyApiUsdSource: Status-page quota card for the local Claude Max 20x plan, 2026-11-26: what 100% of the weekly quota is worth in API-priced USD (ledger rate over the latest sub-window of at least 10 percentage points). The earlier calibration on 2026-11-18 was about $2,146.

openai.name: Codex $200 plan
openai.monthlyUsdSource: https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/pricing (plans at $100, $200 or $500 per month, checked 2026-11-26)
openai.weeklyApiUsdSource: Twice the Codex $100 plan's weekly quota, because only the $100 plan is available locally and the $200 plan is taken as double (user 2026-11-26). The $100 plan's reading is $471.1 = $240.27 of API-priced ledger spend in the current week (22,243 calls, auto-review and compaction calls excluded) / 51% of the weekly quota used, 2026-11-26 (about +/-2% from the integer percentage; spend outside the ledger would make the quota larger). The status card's own sub-window figure ($0.81, from a 10-point sub-window with $0.08 of ledger spend) is not used. Cross-check: the Codex Plus card reads $45.90 a week, and 471.1 is about 10 times that.

google.name: Gemini $200 plan
google.weeklyApiUsdSource: Provided by the user on 2026-11-26 as the $200 plan's weekly quota in API-equivalent USD.

opencode.name: OpenCode Go
opencode.weeklyApiUsdSource: Per-model monthly allowance in API-equivalent USD at the model's list price (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash $100, GLM 5.3 $200; the monthly limits OpenCode publishes for Go, opencode-models.json on the status page, 2026-11-26), spread over the week as monthly / daysPerMonth x 7 (DeepSeek $23.33, GLM $46.67; user 2026-11-26). The measured weekly window (DeepSeek $50.0, GLM $100) is not used.
